z: 僼 izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 僼 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 僽 izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children do not need every desire answered. They need to see a hand open. The open hand is their picture of tomorrow, and tomorrow is either a threat or a table.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 僽 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 僾 izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child believes the sentence more than the apology that follows it. Speak as if the sentence will live in them, because it will. This is not fear. It is care.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is izinyembezi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 僾 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 僿 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The ordinary work, the meal, the repaired hinge, the repeated story, is the curriculum of a family. Thank the labor, not the performance of being easy to live with.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 僿 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 儅 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儅 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 儇 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儇 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 儊 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儊 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 儌 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儌 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 儍 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儍 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 儎 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儎 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 儏 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儏 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 儐 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儐 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 儑 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儑 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 儓 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儓 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 儙 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儙 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 儜 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儜 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 儝 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儝 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 儠 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儠 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 儢 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儢 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 儣 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儣 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 儤 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儤 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 儥 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儥 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 儦 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儦 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 儧 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儧 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 儨 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儨 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 儩 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儩 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 儫 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儫 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 儬 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 儭 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儭 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 儮 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儮 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 儯 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儯 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 儰 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儰 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 儱 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 儳 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儳 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 儴 ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is ijwabu lendlebe, indlebe ephakathi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儴 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 儶 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儶 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 儸 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儸 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 儹 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儹 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 儽 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儽 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 儾 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 儾 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 兂 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兂 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 兏 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兏 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 兑 imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兑 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 兓 imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兓 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 兖 imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兖 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 兘 imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兘 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 兙 imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is imigudu yendlebe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 兙 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.
